rationale: Price has pulled back from the intraday high near $330.70 and the most recent candle closed at $328.23, nearly touching the invalidation level at $327.00, with momentum clearly fading over the last three candles (lower highs and lower lows). With only 22 minutes to close, the 9-EMA at $330.25 is well above current price and the take-profit at $332.50 is unlikely to be reached, while downside risk to the invalidation level is immediate; closing now preserves the small remaining capital rather than risking a forced liquidation at market close or an automatic stop-out.
